column3: “Was no more” renders the present “is no longer.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “I, John.”
“Dwelling place” renders σκηνὴ (“tent”); “man” renders “men”; “His people” renders the plural λαοὶ.
BSB follows the critical text with “He” (the Textus Receptus has “God”). BSB puts the first clause in quotation marks.
BSB follows the critical text with no “to me” and the order “faithful and true.” “This down” is added.
Close to the Greek.
BSB has “all things,” as in the Textus Receptus; the critical text has ταῦτα (“these things”).
BSB has no “sinners” (ἁμαρτωλοῖς). “Place” renders μέρος (“part”).
“Final” renders “last.”
BSB follows the critical text with “the holy city” (no “great”).
“Shining with” renders “having”; “jewel” renders “stone.”
BSB reorders the verse: the names are on the gates, and the twelve angels come last.
Close to the Greek.
“Bearing the names” leaves out “twelve” (δώδεκα) before “names.”
“The angel” is added; BSB follows the critical text with “measuring rod.”
BSB moves “all its dimensions were equal” before the measurements.
“The angel was using” recasts “which is [the measure] of the angel.”
“As pure as glass” renders “like clear glass.”
Close to the Greek.
“Carnelian” renders σάρδιον (“sardius”).
“The main street” renders πλατεῖα.
Close to the Greek.
“Illuminates” renders the aorist “illuminated.”
BSB follows the critical text with no “of those who are saved” and no “and honor.” “Will bring” renders the present “bring.”
“At the end of the day” renders “by day.”
Close to the Greek.
“Unclean” renders κοινὸν (“common”).
